## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, meeting the Sector Strength threshold, but Communication is weakest and Industrials are marginally negative; Technology’s positive weekly return contrasts with a negative monthly return. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology; top five span 3 sectors); these mixed signals argue against a stronger regime call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads at +1.44% for the week and +5.89% for the month, with UNH (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%) and ISRG (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +13.21%) ABOVE TREND. Energy is firm: SLB (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +3.17%), XOM (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +12.99%) and CVX (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +13.40%) are ABOVE TREND; Real Estate gained 1.23% for the week, though constituent breadth is unavailable.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication is weakest at -2.23% for the week and -3.71% for the month, with TMUS (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -11.38%) and T (1W: -10.71% | 1M: -16.83%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary fell 0.76% weekly, with F (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -7.94%) and GM (1W: -9.58% | 1M: -5.77%) BELOW TREND; Industrials slipped 0.05%, with GE (1W: -8.98% | 1M: -10.54%) and CAT (1W: -5.99% | 1M: -14.68%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top five: NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +11.27% | 1M: -2.40%) RECOVERY, LMT (1W: +9.44% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.67%) ABOVE TREND and DOW (1W: +8.95% | 1M: +14.18%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology; top five span 3 sectors), with PANW’s short-term strength not yet confirmed by its monthly trend.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom five: F (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -7.94%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -7.80% | 1M: +1.61%) CORRECTION, AMAT (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -20.46%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -11.38%) BELOW TREND and NEM (1W: -8.20% | 1M: -10.25%) BELOW TREND. Weakness spans consumer, technology, communications and materials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest weekly moves include NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +11.27% | 1M: -2.40%) RECOVERY and LMT (1W: +9.44% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND. PANW is a short-term bounce against its negative month; monitor for confirmation rather than treating it as an established trend change.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: the sector gained 0.69% for the week but lost 0.95% for the month; constituent positive-stock breadth was not provided (24 stocks). NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) and IBM (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.67%) are ABOVE TREND, while MSFT (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +5.34%) is in CORRECTION and NVDA (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.06%), META (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -17.36%) and AMAT (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -20.46%) are BELOW TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are nearly flat weekly (+0.02%) but up 1.37% monthly; constituent positive-stock breadth was not provided (20 stocks). V (1W: +1.32% | 1M: +10.85%) and MA (1W: +1.00% | 1M: +10.33%) are ABOVE TREND, while JPM (1W: -2.40% | 1M: -1.57%) is BELOW TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare leads on both periods, +1.44% weekly and +5.89% monthly; constituent positive-stock breadth was not provided (17 stocks). UNH (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%), LLY (1W: +1.31% | 1M: +7.75%) and ISRG (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +13.21%) are ABOVE TREND, though ISRG’s negative news sentiment diverges from its price strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to healthcare and energy relative strength, while monitoring high-momentum technology names for follow-through; reduce exposure to persistent laggards such as META (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -17.36%) BELOW TREND and AMAT (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -20.46%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed, with no confirmed Growth-versus-Value leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LMT (1W: +9.44% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%) ABOVE TREND, if their recent strength persists. BEARISH: AMAT (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -20.46%) BELOW TREND and META (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -17.36%) BELOW TREND, with semiconductor supply concerns and sustained weakness risks.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (+1.44% weekly; +5.89% monthly) and Energy (+0.93% weekly; +11.03% monthly), with broad sector positive-stock counts unavailable. BEARISH: Communication (-2.23% weekly; -3.71% monthly) and Consumer Discretionary (-0.76% weekly), where recent sector momentum remains weak.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not supplied; use trend confirmation instead. Watch whether PANW (1W: +11.27% | 1M: -2.40%) RECOVERY holds its weekly advance, and whether MSFT (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +5.34%) CORRECTION resumes its monthly trend or weakens further; NVDA (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.06%) BELOW TREND needs a sustained reversal to signal stabilization.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LMT (+55): earnings beat and F-35 deal; price ABOVE TREND at (1W: +9.44% | 1M: +15.37%), confirming. UNH (+55): beat-and-raise quarter; ABOVE TREND at (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%), confirming; AMZN (+50): cloud capacity reportedly sold out through 2027, but BELOW TREND at (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -0.55%), diverging; TSLA (+45): semi volume output and AI-component investment, RECOVERY at (1W: +4.93% | 1M: -1.51%), awaiting confirmation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ISRG (-55): slower da Vinci growth; ABOVE TREND at (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +13.21%), a price-sentiment divergence to monitor. LRCX (-40): supply warning weighs on chip stocks, BELOW TREND at (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -25.09%), confirming; AMAT (-35): sector concerns, BELOW TREND at (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -20.46%), confirming; F (-35): Europe weakness, BELOW TREND at (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -7.94%), confirming.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION: Breadth is 8/11 sectors positive, with Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology; top five span 3 sectors); style is mixed, with no clear Growth-versus-Value leadership. NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%) ABOVE TREND show relative strength. Monitor technology’s mixed timeframe profile and the divergence between ISRG’s negative news sentiment and its ABOVE TREND price action.
